## Profile

I am a mechanical engineer with a master's degree and a PhD in Metrology. My applied research involves ultrasound, scientific instrumentation, calibration and measurement-system automation. My work combines experimental systems, signal processing, statistics and scientific programming.

I also have professional experience in quality management systems, measurement systems analysis and auditing. I am currently pursuing further study and research interests in artificial intelligence and *machine learning* applied to measurement problems.
